title: Fix header toolbar horizontal overflow at tablet/mobile widths
description: The canvas page header toolbar causes horizontal page overflow at viewport widths <= 768px (tablet and below). Reproduction: 1. Open app at http://localhost:5173 2. Navigate to any stream (click Open) 3. Resize browser to 768px width (or use DevTools tablet emulation) 4. Observe: page scrolls horizontally, body scrollWidth (879px) exceeds viewport (768px) Cause: The right-side toolbar in app-shell.tsx header contains ~7 buttons/elements (Stream Details, Stats, divider, Import, Export, divider, ThemeToggle, SaveIndicator) in a `flex items-center gap-2` container with no overflow handling or responsive wrapping. The landing page does NOT overflow at 768px — only the canvas view header. Fix options (pick simplest): 1. Add `overflow-hidden` to the header and `flex-shrink min-w-0` to the right toolbar 2. Hide text labels on buttons at `md:` breakpoint, showing only icons: `Import` 3. Use `flex-wrap` on the toolbar with appropriate height handling 4. Collapse less-used buttons (Import/Export) into a dropdown menu at smaller widths Option 2 is recommended — hide button text labels below `lg:` (1024px) so only icons show. This matches common responsive toolbar patterns and maintains all functionality. Verified via Puppeteer at 768px viewport: elements with class `flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-500` overflow to right: 879px.
